newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - APPLE EXTENDS RISE.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - APPLE EXTENDS RISE.

text.p: Shares in Apple Computer Inc extended their climb in trading ahead of the opening on Wall Street Thursday amid positive sentiment following news of measures to bolster the ailing computer maker, traders said.
One trader cited Apple at 27-3/16, another listed a trade at 27-1/4, up from Apple's close Wednesday at 26-5/16.
Apple rose 6-9/16 on Wednesday on news Microsoft Corp was investing $150 million in Apple and Apple was revamping its board of directors.
A Bear Stearns source also said that firm was upgrading its rating on Apple to attractive from unattractive.

Traders said Compaq Computer Corp also rose in pre-opening trading, bolstered by an upgrade from Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette. One trader cited a Compaq trade at 59-1/2 and another at 60, up from its close Wednesday at 58-10/16.
DLJ added Compaq to its recommended list.

In other action CIENA Corp traded down after saying it expected third quarter earnings to be better than expected but said investors should not be surprised to see moderating sequential growth for the company in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 and the first quarter of fiscal 1998. The stock traded at 50 after closing at 54-3/16, traders said.
